mechanism: Hydrocodone is metabolized by CYP2D6 and has serotonergic activity; isocarboxazid is an MAOI that inhibits monoamine metabolism, creating risk for serotonin syndrome and increased opioid effects through enzyme inhibition and additive CNS depression.
action: Avoid this combination; if opioid therapy is necessary, use alternative analgesics not metabolized by CYP2D6 and implement careful monitoring with washout periods or switch to safer MAOI alternatives.
